author: phoenix_OMEGA
what_it_is: At the last save spot. All 108 characters collected and alive; all Window and Sound Settings, Paints and all other collectables in the game. Maxed-out money. Party level is 58 on average, and all weapons for party characters are max level.
format: DexDrive .gme: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header (per-block comments) + 131072-byte raw card; the card holds 12 save(s), 1 for this game (BASLUS-00292GENSOU01)
